proposed_comments.title: Avoid caching a failed file-type lookup under the shared alias
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid caching a failed file-type lookup under the shared alias

**Severity:** `medium`

When a provisional file-type lookup fails, the fallback identity is path-specific but can still be cached through the type-wide alias. That lets one unavailable or unusual file poison previews for every item with the same extension. Keep the fallback identity usable for the current request, but do not store it under the shared file-type alias.

```suggestion
        return new LocatedShellIcon(
            request,
            ShellIconIdentity.FromItemPath(request.ItemPath, request.Jumbo),
            request.LocationMode != ShellItemIconLocationMode.FileType);
```

proposed_comments.title: Do not cache an empty materialized shell image
Preserve the provisional type icon when exact extraction falls back
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the provisional type icon when exact extraction falls back

**Severity:** `medium`

The progressive path can publish a useful file-type preview and then replace it with the generic Shell fallback when exact extraction cannot produce item-specific content. Keep the exact icon only when it contains real content; otherwise preserve the intermediate source.

```suggestion
                return exact is not null && !ShellItemIconFallback.IsFallback(exact)
                    ? exact
                    : intermediate ?? exact;
```

proposed_comments.title: Remove the misleading extraction-avoidance percentage

review.body: Thanks for the PR. I found four edge-case icon caching issues that should be addressed before merging.

judgment.rationale: The current head can poison shared aliases after a failed file-type lookup, cache blank materialized images, regress from useful provisional icons to generic fallback, and report a percentage derived from incompatible request and extraction counts.
evidence: FileType failures construct a path-specific fallback identity but can still cache it through an extension-wide alias.
Image materialization can return a non-null icon source with a null ImageSource that downstream caching accepts.
Progressive exact extraction can replace an existing type preview with the explicit generic fallback sentinel.
A progressive request may perform multiple extractions, invalidating the reported avoidance percentage.
